reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as WC-reinforced HEA coatings are known to refine microstructure and improve hardness/wear resistance, though the specific 30-50% hardness increase and 50% wear reduction are optimistic and depend heavily on unoptimized parameters.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with well-defined measurements and a decisive falsification criterion based on quantitative thresholds, though the exact thresholds (30% hardness, 50% wear) are somewhat arbitrary.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful for researchers in this field, as it proposes a specific, testable coating system with clear mechanisms and boundaries, directly addressing the research question.
